verdicts.tldr: GetNameSourceForPath still panics with a nil-pointer dereference for three shapes whose name has no declaring file: a zero NameSource from Define, a nil FileSet, and a uverse path.
verdicts.details: The new godoc says the returned *FileNode is nil when the name has no declaring file. Line 2085 reads nsrc.NameExpr.Name, nil for every name Define or Define2 adds (uverse.go:756 `Define2(true, n, tv.T, tv, NameSource{})`, keeper.go:1261 `mpn.Define("pkg", ...)`), and pn.GetDeclForSafe reads fs.Files through the embedded *FileSet, nil for NewPackageNode(..., nil) (uverse.go:752, keeper.go:1260). Only the empty-FileSet Reserve shape the PR targets returns nil. The defect predates the diff, which sweeps this class (names with no declaring file) and misses these members; latent, since the helper has no caller outside its interface and the test, and #6089 rejects VPUverse before calling it. Guarding the call with `nsrc.NameExpr != nil && pn.FileSet != nil` makes all four shapes return a nil file, the PR's test and go test -short ./gnovm/pkg/repl green.
verdicts.evidence: head: `emptyFileSet+Reserve, nil store: ok fnNil=true type=2`; `emptyFileSet+Define: PANIC runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference`; `nilFileSet+Reserve: PANIC ...nil pointer dereference`; `uverse true: PANIC ...nil pointer dereference`. base nodes.go: the same three nil-pointer panics, and the Reserve shape panics `name outVar not defined in fileset with files []`. With judge-1-guard.patch: all four `ok fnNil=true`, `--- PASS: TestGetNameSourceForPathNoFilesetDecl`, `ok github.com/gnolang/gno/gnovm/pkg/repl 2.232s`.
